selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable IPv4 ICMP redirect and source-route acceptance
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the persistent sysctl file and zero values for both settings across all, default, enp1s0, and loopback before and after restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep the installed operating-system release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Confirms RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 remained installed.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 6d37896c-e0cd-4fe7-acbf-94fc35781e09, restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID cb980bba-7d28-49ce-8c6c-1f57692b37c0, and recovered system/network health with persistent hardening intact.

commands.command:
if [ -e /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf ]; then printf 'EXISTING_FILE
'; stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; sed -n '1,120p' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; else printf 'NO_EXISTING_FILE
'; fi; printf 'IDENTITY
'; id

umask 022; tmpfile=$(mktemp /etc/sysctl.d/.99-network-hardening.conf.XXXXXX) || exit 1; trap 'rm -f "$tmpfile"' EXIT HUP INT TERM; cat >"$tmpfile" <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
# Disable acceptance of IPv4 ICMP redirects and source-routed packets.
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.*.accept_source_route = 0
ANTRIEB_EOF
chown root:root "$tmpfile" && chmod 0644 "$tmpfile" && mv -f "$tmpfile" /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; rc=$?; trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM; exit "$rc"
systemctl restart systemd-sysctl.service; rc=$?; printf 'SYSTEMD_SYSCTL_ACTIVE='; systemctl is-active systemd-sysctl.service; exit "$rc"

printf 'PERSISTENT_FILE
'; stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; cat /etc/sysctl.d/99-network-hardening.conf; printf 'RUNTIME_VALUES
'; bad=0; for p in /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_redirects /proc/sys/net/ipv4/conf/*/accept_source_route; do v=$(cat "$p"); printf '%s=%s
' "$p" "$v"; [ "$v" = 0 ] || bad=1; done; printf 'ALL_VALUES_ZERO=%s
' "$([ "$bad" -eq 0 ] && printf yes || printf no)"; exit "$bad"
